title: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) — Mock 07
pattern: WCL Asst. Foreman (Electrical) CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 120 min · no −ve)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Earthing grid in a substation is made of:
questions.solution: Copper: low resistance, corrosion resistant

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The resistance of earth electrode depends on:
questions.solution: R depends on resistivity (ohm-m), electrode size, depth

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Soil resistivity is measured using:
questions.solution: Wenner: 4 pins equally spaced in soil

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Parallel earth pits reduce total resistance because:
questions.solution: Parallel: Req = R/n for n equal pits

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Bonding means:
options: Connecting metallic parts to earth system
questions.solution: Bonding: ensures all metalwork is at earth potential

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Neutral earthing and body earthing are kept:
questions.solution: Separate pits to avoid mutual interference

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: For electrical machinery and plant, the competent person for inspection under CMR 2017 shall be an engineer or electrician holding qualifications specified in:
options: CEA (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations, 2010
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 213(6): the competent person for electrical machinery holds qualifications as specified in the CEA Safety & Electric Supply Regulations, 2010.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The earth continuity conductor is connected to:
options: All exposed metallic parts of equipment
questions.solution: ECC connects to all exposed metal parts

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Chemical earthing reduces resistance by:
questions.solution: Chemical compound improves local soil conductivity

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Earth mat in HV substations is designed to limit:
options: Step and touch potential to safe values
questions.solution: Earth mat: keeps step/touch potential within safe limits

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Earthing transformer is used in:
options: Delta systems to create artificial neutral
questions.solution: Earthing T/F: provides neutral point in ungrounded systems

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An unearthed system fault to earth causes:
options: An immediate tripping of the breaker
Small capacitive current, system can continue
questions.solution: Ungrounded: fault current limited by system capacitance

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A Petersen coil is used to:
options: Resonate with system capacitance to reduce earth fault current
questions.solution: Petersen coil: arc suppression reactor

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Earth resistance test by fall of potential method uses:
questions.solution: 3-point: earth E, potential P, current C

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The permissible earth resistance for LT distribution is:
questions.solution: IS 3043: R < 5 ohm for systems up to 100kVA

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Equipotential bonding reduces:
questions.solution: Bonding: eliminates dangerous potential differences

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Effective earthing fault clearance time for 415V system is:
questions.solution: 415V: disconnection within 5 seconds for safety

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: RCD (Residual Current Device) operates by detecting:
options: Difference between phase and neutral currents
questions.solution: RCD: residual current (leakage) = I_phase - I_neutral

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: RCD sensitivity of 30mA protects against:
questions.solution: 30mA for 40ms prevents fatal ventricular fibrillation

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The earth electrode resistance decreases when:
questions.solution: Moist soil: lower resistivity -> lower R

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A rising neutral potential in an unearthed system indicates:
questions.solution: Neutral shift indicates earth fault

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a thorough inspection of all machinery and plant in use is required at least once in every:
options: 7 days, recorded in a bound paged book
10 days, recorded in the log book
48 hours when work is in progress
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 213(5): a competent person thoroughly inspects all machinery and plant at least once in 7 days, recording results in a bound paged book.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: For an industrial unit, separate earthing for motor and structure is:
questions.solution: Separate pits recommended for equipment and structure

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In a gassy seam of the second or third degree, no person shall supervise or operate electrical machinery unless he:
options: Holds a gas-testing certificate and carries an approved flame safety lamp
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 213(2): in 2nd/3rd-degree gassy seams, operators of electrical machinery (other than telephones/signals/lamps) hold a gas-testing certificate and carry an approved flame safety lamp.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An earth fault relay connected in residual connection of CTs detects:
questions.solution: Residual CT: 3I0, detects earth fault only

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The resistance of a driven rod earthing decreases with:
questions.solution: More depth reaches lower resistivity soil layers

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A rescue-trained person shall practise with breathing apparatus at least:
options: 8 times a year, of which 4 in mines
4 times a year, of which 2 in mines
questions.solution: MRR 1985: rescue-trained persons practise with breathing apparatus at least 8 times a year, including 4 practices in the mine.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A 300mm x 300mm x 12mm copper plate earthing pit depth should be:
questions.solution: Plate electrode: minimum 3m depth

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cross bonding in cables is done to:
questions.solution: Cross bonding: reduces induced sheath voltages

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A solidly earthed neutral allows:
options: Full fault current to flow during earth fault
questions.solution: Solid earth: low impedance path -> full fault current

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The maximum touch voltage during a fault depends on:
options: Fault current, earth resistance, and mat resistance
questions.solution: Touch V = f(If, Re, Rmat)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In IT system (isolated neutral), first earth fault:
questions.solution: IT system: first fault alarm, second fault trips

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Earthing of a building lightning protection system connects to:
options: Nearby earth electrode or earthing system
questions.solution: Lightning earth: connects to general earthing system

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A rod earthing system typically uses rods of length:
questions.solution: Standard: 2.4-3m driven rods

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The soil resistivity of rocky terrain is typically:
questions.solution: Rocky: > 1000 ohm-m; clay/moist: 10-100 ohm-m

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An earthing system for a 33kV substation typically needs earth resistance:
questions.solution: 33kV: Re < 1 ohm for safety

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Isolated neutral system is also known as:
questions.solution: IT: Isolé-Terre (French notation)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: TT earthing system means:
options: Separate earth for source and consumer
questions.solution: TT: source and load have separate earth electrodes

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: TN-S earthing system has:
options: Separate protective earth and neutral throughout
questions.solution: TN-S: separate PE and N from source to load

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A high resistance earthing system limits fault current to:
questions.solution: HRG: limits to 5-10A for continuous operation

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The voltage rating of a lightning arrestor is selected based on:
options: Maximum system voltage and earthing type
questions.solution: LA rating: depends on system voltage and neutral earthing

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Single bus bar scheme has:
questions.solution: Single bus: simplest, all feeders on one bus

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Double bus bar scheme provides:
options: Flexibility to transfer feeders between buses
questions.solution: Double bus: transfer feeders for maintenance/operation

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: One-and-a-half breaker scheme uses:
questions.solution: 1.5 breaker: 3 breakers protect 2 circuits

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An isolator is used for:
questions.solution: Isolator: visible gap for safe maintenance

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Lightning arrester is installed at:
questions.solution: LA: at line entry to protect equipment from surges

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A substation battery provides:
options: DC supply for protection and control
questions.solution: Battery: DC for relay, trip coil, control circuits

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: CT in a substation is used for:
questions.solution: CT: steps down current for metering and protection

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: PT in a substation is used for:
questions.solution: PT: steps down voltage for measurement

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Bus bar in a substation is rated for:
options: Maximum current it can carry continuously
questions.solution: Bus rating: continuous current capacity in kA

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A bus coupler connects:
questions.solution: Bus coupler: interconnects bus sections

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: LA withstand voltage should be:
options: Higher than system voltage but lower than equipment BIL
questions.solution: LA withstand > system voltage, but protects equipment

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: BIL (Basic Insulation Level) is:
questions.solution: BIL: peak impulse voltage equipment can withstand

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A substation control room houses:
questions.solution: Control room: relays, batteries, SCADA, metering

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Minimum clearance between phase conductors at 11kV:
questions.solution: 11kV: ~200mm phase clearance

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: An isolator interlock prevents:
options: Opening under load or closing on fault
questions.solution: Interlock: prevents incorrect operation

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The purpose of a marshalling box is to:
questions.solution: Marshalling box: cable termination and organization

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: GIS (Gas Insulated Substation) uses:
questions.solution: GIS: SF6 gas insulated, compact design

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: DC battery voltage in a substation is typically:
questions.solution: Standard: 110V or 220V DC for protection and control

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Battery charger in substation charges battery at:
questions.solution: Float: normal; boost: fast charge after discharge

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: If the percentage of inflammable gas in the general body of air exceeds ______, persons shall be withdrawn from the working.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 166: persons are withdrawn when the general body of air exceeds 1.25% inflammable gas.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A substation transformer oil test checks:
questions.solution: Oil test: BDV, moisture, acidity, sludge

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Approaching a goaf, probing shall be carried out ahead of the working for at least:
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 147: the working is probed ahead for at least 1.5 m beyond the last support before approaching the goaf.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The fire wall between transformers is made of:
questions.solution: Fire wall: RCC, 4-hour fire rating minimum

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Cable termination kit in substation is used for:
questions.solution: Termination: stress cone, insulation, seal

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The rating of a substation transformer is expressed in:
questions.solution: Transformer: MVA (apparent power)

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: On-load tap changer (OLTC) is used to:
options: Vary turns ratio under load for voltage regulation
questions.solution: OLTC: adjusts voltage ratio while carrying load

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: While driving approaching old or waterlogged workings, advance boreholes shall be kept at least ______ ahead of the face.
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 163: at least 3 advance boreholes not less than 3 m ahead of the face, with flank holes within 5 m on either side.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A current transformer secondary should be grounded at:
questions.solution: CT secondary: single point earth for safety

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The function of a surge capacitor is to:
questions.solution: Surge cap: diverts high-frequency transients

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Substation fencing height should be minimum:
questions.solution: Standard: 2.4m minimum height with barbed wire

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: SF6 gas in GIS is used because it has:
options: High dielectric strength and arc quenching property
questions.solution: SF6: 2.5x air dielectric, excellent arc quenching

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Every mechanised outlet (shaft or incline) is examined at least once in every 7 days by:
options: An engineer, electrical supervisor or foreman, or a competent person authorised by the engineer
The district magistrate of the area
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 75(2): mechanised outlets are examined at least once in 7 days by an engineer, electrical supervisor or foreman (or authorised competent person), recorded in a bound paged book.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: In gassy mines, electric lighting from a source external to the lighting unit may be used on any roadway or place:
options: Ventilated by intake air or not within 270 m of the nearest face
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 176(1): external-source electric lighting is permitted on intake-air roadways or places not within 270 m of the nearest face.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: The minimum approach distance (MAD) at 33kV is:
questions.solution: 33kV: ~0.6m MAD for safe working

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: As per DGMS Circular 2/2010, strata and dump slope monitoring is mandatory for dumps exceeding ______ in height.
questions.solution: DGMS Circular 2/2010: monitoring (including slope stability radar / real-time monitoring) is made mandatory for dumps exceeding 60 m height.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Substation insulator string for 33kV typically has how many discs?
questions.solution: 33kV: approximately 3 suspension insulator discs

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: A substation SCADA system monitors and controls:
options: Remote operation of switchgear and parameters
questions.solution: SCADA: supervisory control and data acquisition

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: DGMS (Tech.) (S&T) Circular No. 02 of 2010 deals with:
options: Design, control and monitoring of pit and dump slopes in opencast mines
questions.solution: DGMS (Tech.) (S&T) Circular No. 02 dated 06.07.2010 concerns design, control and monitoring of pit and dump slopes in opencast mines.

questions.subject: Electrical Engineering
questions.stem: Every engine, motor, transformer and battery-charging room on the surface of a mine shall be provided with at least:
options: Two exits, properly maintained and kept free from obstruction
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 212: such rooms are kept clean and provided with at least two exits, properly maintained and free from obstruction.

questions.solution: 1/12+1/18=5/36; together 7.2 days

questions.stem: What is the square root of 144?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Ratio of 40 min to 2 hours is:

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: In a code language, if CAT is written as DBU, DOG is written as:
questions.solution: Each letter +1: D, E, P, H

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Pointing to a man, she said: He is my mother's only son. He is my:
questions.solution: Mother's only son = brother

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: A is north of B, B is west of C. A is in which direction of C?
questions.solution: A is NW of C

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: All dogs are cats. All cats are birds. Conclusion: All dogs are birds.
questions.solution: Dogs->cats->birds: valid syllogism

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Odd one out: Apple, Mango, Potato, Banana
questions.solution: Potato is vegetable; others are fruits

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Analogy: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.solution: Doctor in hospital; teacher in school

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: In a row of 30 students, A is 10th from left. Position from right:
questions.solution: 30-10+1=21st from right

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Statement: All flowers are fruits. No fruit is sweet. Conclusion: No flower is sweet.
questions.solution: Flowers->fruits, no fruit sweet -> no flower sweet

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Direction: A walks 10m north, turns left, walks 5m, turns left again, walks 10m. Final position?
questions.solution: U-shape: ends 5m west of start

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Series: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?:
questions.solution: Pattern: EV

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: A clock shows 3:15. Angle between hands:
questions.solution: At 3:15: minute hand at 90°, hour at 97.5°, diff = 7.5°

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.solution: 9 is not prime; rest are primes

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: If yesterday was two days before Saturday, what is today?
questions.solution: Sat-2=Thu; today=Fri

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.stem: Statement: Some cats are dogs. All dogs are birds. Conclusion: Some cats are birds.
questions.solution: Some cats->dogs->birds: definitely true
